init.title: NWP500 Options
init.description: Configure advanced settings for your Navien NWP500 integration.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll device status (10-300 seconds). Lower values provide faster updates but may increase server load. Default: 30 seconds.
data_description.control_enabled: Let an external scheduler control the heater through an intent entity. Off by default; enabling starts in shadow mode, which writes nothing. See docs/external-control.md.

external_control.title: External control (protocol 1)
external_control.description: The scheduler publishes each plan to the intent entity: its state is the intent id and its attributes are the plan. The feature programs the plan into the heater's reservation list, so the heater keeps following it if Home Assistant is unavailable. Shadow mode plans and reports what it would program, and writes nothing. Live mode, when offered, writes the list.

data.control_min_run_before_lower_min: Minimum run before lowering a surplus raise

data_description.control_intent_entity: Any entity whose state changes on every new intent and whose attributes carry the intent document.
data_description.control_mode: Shadow plans the reservation list and reports it without writing anything. Live writes it to the heater. Disabled hands the heater back to the owner's program once, then writes nothing further.
data_description.control_surplus_entity: A binary sensor (on = surplus) or a power sensor in kW. Required for surplus grants.
data_description.control_surplus_threshold_kw: For a power sensor: surplus when its value is at or above this. Default is the heat pump's running power.
data_description.control_setpoint_min: Leave empty to follow the device's own minimum. A plan's "min" setpoint means this value.
data_description.control_setpoint_max: Leave empty to follow the device's own maximum.
data_description.control_allowed_modes: Modes a plan's segments may use. Vacation and power-off are never allowed. Start a cut-over with one mode, so no entry changes the mode.
data_description.control_assisted_mode: The mode a scheduler should use for faster recovery. Must be one of the allowed modes.
data_description.control_reservation_entry_limit: The most reservation entries the feature lets the list hold. The unit tested held 32; 16 leaves room.
data_description.control_reservation_entry_reserve: Entries kept free for changes needed now: a segment already begun, and surplus raises. Must be below the limit.
data_description.control_min_run_before_lower_min: A surplus raise is lowered once surplus has been gone for 15 minutes, but not before the compressor has run this long. It is always lowered when the compressor stops.
data_description.control_live_segments: In live, write the plan's segments to the heater. Off: segments are evaluated as in shadow.
data_description.control_live_grants: In live, write surplus raises too. Needs live segments.

going_live.title: Going live: the owner's program

error.setpoint_range: The minimum must be below the maximum.
error.reserve_exceeds_limit: The reserve must be below the entry limit.
error.assisted_mode_not_allowed: The assisted mode must be one of the allowed modes.
error.owner_snapshot_unavailable: The heater's program cannot be read yet. Wait for the heater to report its mode, setpoint and reservation list, and take it out of vacation or power-off, then submit again.
error.grants_need_segments: Surplus grants can be live only with segments live.

set_reservation.name: Set Reservation
set_reservation.description: Create or update a single reservation schedule entry. An existing entry scheduled for the same days and time is replaced, so repeating a call updates it rather than adding a duplicate. Reservations allow automatic mode and temperature changes at scheduled times. The device supports up to 16 reservation entries.

enabled.description: Whether this reservation entry is active

days.description: Days of the week for this reservation. Select one or more days.

hour.description: Hour of day (0-23) when reservation activates

minute.description: Minute of hour (0-59) when reservation activates

mode.name: Operation Mode
mode.description: DHW operation mode to set when reservation activates

temperature.description: Target temperature in Fahrenheit (80-150°F). Required for heating modes, ignored for vacation and power off modes.

entity_id.description: The entity ID of the water heater (alternative to Device ID)

get_energy_usage.description: Ask the water heater for its recorded energy usage and return it as a report. The device keeps daily totals split between the heat pump and the electric heating elements; nothing is recorded in Home Assistant, the data is returned to the caller. Defaults to the current month. Ask for whole years instead to get one total per month.
